p: have called by name Bezaleel the: I have chosen and made meet, Ex 35:30.
workmanship: This shows that handicrafts are the gifts of God's spirit, and therefore ought to be esteemed.
wise hearted I have put wisdom: I have instructed them, and increased their knowledge.
pure candlestick with all his furniture: So called, because of the cunning and art used in them, or because the whole was beaten out of the piece.
anointing oil: Which was only to anoint the Priests and the instruments of the tabernacle, not to burn.
Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: Though I command that these works be done, yet I do not want you to break my Sabbath days.
sabbath therefore: God repeats this point because the whole keeping of the law stands in the true use of the sabbath, which is to stop working and so obey the will of God.
rested: From creating his creatures, but not from governing and preserving them.
of testimony: By which he declared his will to his people.
